scope: NSB designer counterparts of every legacy armour stockpile grant and production licence in focuses, events and decisions. A row resolves one producer's legacy tier to the historical design that producer fields: the national preset it already owns (canonical, same recipe and flag) or, where no preset exists, a supplied design named from live localisation on the generation recipe.
